instagram_reel.script:
Okay, Grüner Veltliner fans, this one is for you. I spotted the Urbanihof 4U 2024 Grüner Veltliner at the LCBO, and it’s exactly the kind of bottle I love finding.

It’s light, it’s approachable, and it still has depth. Think lemon meringue, pear, baked apple, a little honeysuckle — and then on the palate, you get lemon-lime, green apple, melon, white pepper, and even a tiny bit of nuttiness.

It’s 12% alcohol, it’s easy to drink now, and honestly, this feels very patio-friendly. If you’ve been curious about Grüner, this is a really nice place to start.

linkedin.post:
When I’m recommending wine, I’m always looking for bottles that feel approachable without being simple.

That’s why the Urbanihof 4U 2024 Grüner Veltliner caught my attention as an LCBO find. It’s a great example of a white wine that gives you freshness, texture, and a little personality all at once.

It’s light in body, 12% ABV, and clearly in the drink-now category. The profile is aromatic and layered, with notes like lemon meringue, pear, baked apple pie, honeysuckle, lemon-lime, green apple, melon, white pepper, and a touch of nuttiness.

For trade, this is the kind of bottle that can convert curious drinkers into Grüner fans fast. For buyers and retailers, it also checks an important box: accessible price point, broad appeal, and enough character to stand out on shelf.

At $21.95 at the LCBO, it’s a solid example of how an everyday white can still feel elevated.
